items.title: Coca-Cola Stock Pops After Earnings Shine a Light on Consumer Spending
items.summary: Coca-Cola  stock was rising on Tuesday after the soft drink company reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its full-year guidance, signaling to investors that demand for fizzy drinks remains robust.  Coca-Cola reported adjusted earnings of 97 cents a share, as revenue jumped 7% from a year ago to $13.4 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of 93 cents a share on revenue of $13.2 billion, according to a FactSet poll.

items.title: JetBlue Loss Widens Due to Higher Fuel Costs
items.summary: JetBlue Airways recorded a bigger loss in the second quarter stemming from higher jet fuel prices, though it blunted about half of that damage with higher fares and strong customer demand.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Cuts Revenue Outlook as Bookings Remain Pressured
